compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined The sons of the mighty are summoned to worship beside The army of heaven worships its maker; All gods are called to worship the reigning LORD; Angels and armies obey the heavenly throne; Angels and the heavenly army praise their creator. Those passages share its heavenly-assembly evidence group or Scripture movement, but none supplies a distinct two-source relationship stronger than the accepted comparisons already carrying this topic.
